mentions.name: IRS Church Data Aggregator
mentions.description: This project fetches every church from IRS data and uses a small LLM (qwen2.5-14b) running locally on a Mac mini to match each church to its Google search result, with a current 30% match rate. It then fetches church websites and, eventually, runs a data enrichment LLM pass to determine positions, metadata, and services offered, so the data can be seen in aggregate while keeping processing costs low. A stretch goal is transcribing the sermons most churches link to via videos and running an LLM pass to look for toxic traits, speaking truth to power about churches turning a blind eye to the current political moment.
